coverage.evidence: .github/workflows/release.yml:168-177 sets up the binaries job with the matrix rid [win-x64, linux-x64, linux-arm64, osx-x64, osx-arm64], and the publish at :190-194 uses --self-contained true -p:BundleDashboard=true. This matches page lines 7, 16-17 and the archive table at 35-41.

.github/workflows/release.yml:203-213 sets stage=nomnomz-${version}-${rid}, zips win-* into ${stage}.zip and tars the others into ${stage}.tar.gz. The stage folder is archived itself, which matches page line 46 (one folder named like the archive). The csproj sets AssemblyName nomnomz (NomNomzBot.Api.csproj:28), which gives nomnomz.exe on Windows and nomnomz elsewhere. The version format ${ch}-YYYY.MM.DD-RUN at release.yml:113 matches the example stable-2026.11.01-412.
.github/workflows/release.yml:168-172 runs the binaries job only if channel == 'stable' and says in a comment that nightly/beta ship as images. This matches page line 29.

DEPLOY.md:50-52 says to unzip/untar and run nomnomz (nomnomz.exe on Windows), and DEPLOY.md:87-88 says to open http://localhost:5080. appsettings.json:2 has Urls http://localhost:5080. No startup code opens a browser: UseShellExecute appears only in SystemTrayHostedService.cs:368 and :343, both from tray actions. This matches page line 79.

DEPLOY.md:87-88 says the first start creates the data folder and walks you through setup in the dashboard. SelfHostDataPaths.cs:78-84 calls Directory.CreateDirectory on first access. This matches page line 84.

SelfHostDataPaths.cs:16-24 names %LOCALAPPDATA%\NomNomzBot, ~/.local/share/NomNomzBot and ~/Library/Application Support/NomNomzBot. The database is at :30, logs at :42, keys at :44 and :47. This matches page lines 156-162.
SelfHostDataPaths.cs:66-78 reads NOMNOMZ_DATA_DIR on every process start and falls back to LocalApplicationData/NomNomzBot when it is unset. This matches page lines 172-173.

ListenPortBootstrap.cs:28 has DefaultSelfHostPort 5080. Line :92 reads the lock, :127-128 writes the lock on the first boot, and :99-100 aborts on a conflict. ListenPortResolver.Resolve uses lockedPort ?? preferredPort. ListenPortResolution.cs:41-51 holds the exact messages 'Listening on {Port}.', 'Port {PreferredPort} is held by another application — listening on {Port} instead', and 'Port {Port} is reserved for this bot ... The bot will not move to a different port because that would break every saved login.' SelfHostDataPaths.cs:64 names the file listen-port, and LockedPortStore.cs:74 writes the plain number. ListenPortBootstrap.cs:121-123 sets App:BaseUrl to localhost:{port}, which supports the sign-in address claim on page line 114.

NomNomzBot.Api.csproj:27 sets OutputType WinExe (no console). SystemTrayMenu.cs:74-79 has the menu items 'Open in browser' and 'Stop NomNomzBot'. SystemTrayMenu.cs:71 gives the tooltip 'NomNomzBot — running on http://localhost:{port}'. SystemTrayHostedService.cs:204 shows the balloon 'NomNomzBot is running on {url}', and :378-380 removes the icon when the bot stops. Program.cs:424-436 registers the tray only after the port resolves, so a port conflict means no tray icon. This matches page lines 53-57, 93-95 and 131-132.

DEPLOY.md:88-89 says to update by downloading the newer release and replacing the binary, and that the data stays in place. Page lines 242-243 link to /reference/self-hosting/updates#update-without-docker, and updates.mdx:202 has the heading 'Update without Docker'.

reader_answers.evidence: The archive endings match release.yml:177 and :207-212. The tray item 'Open in browser' matches SystemTrayMenu.cs:77. localhost:5080 matches appsettings.json:2. The data folder paths match SelfHostDataPaths.cs:20-21. Backing up the whole folder matches DEPLOY.md:47.

A 64-bit system is required: the RIDs are only x64 and arm64 (release.yml:177). The data folder must be set before the first start because it is created on first access (SelfHostDataPaths.cs:78). The port must be set before the first start because the first-boot lock wins afterwards (ListenPortBootstrap.cs:92, :127-128).
The tray notice matches SystemTrayHostedService.cs:204. 'Listening on 5080.' matches ListenPortResolution.cs:41, logged to the console bootstrap logger (Program.cs:39, :422-428).

NOMNOMZ_DATA_DIR is read on every start (SelfHostDataPaths.cs:68). The port is locked in listen-port and reused (ListenPortBootstrap.cs:92, :127-128; SelfHostDataPaths.cs:64) because of the OAuth redirect URLs (ListenPortBootstrap.cs:119-123). A later conflict aborts the start (ListenPortBootstrap.cs:95-100).
